roadmap_items: Findings classified as defect, preference, or scope expansion
purpose: Make authorized Phase 10.2 audio preference and listening evaluation actionable without recording participant results or implying audio, accessibility, educational, or release approval.

audience_and_use_case.primary_users: authorized evaluators comparing optional presentation audio
audience_and_use_case.supporting_users: facilitators administering a bounded local session
audience_and_use_case.job_to_be_done: compare audio modes and fallbacks, report usefulness/fatigue and lost meaning, and retain the same written decision context without sound
audience_and_use_case.default_setup: local loopback host, Chromium, 1024x768 planning baseline, seeded competitive-regional-v1 session, audio optional
audience_and_use_case.facilitator_boundary: provide setup, consent, stop, and accommodation guidance without teaching hidden state or promising an audio outcome

source_contract.facilitator_audio_sequence: docs/guides/phase10.2-structured-evaluation.md: Try full audio, cues-only, mute, reduced notifications, unavailable audio
source_contract.facilitator_audio_off: docs/guides/phase10.2-structured-evaluation.md: Begin with audio off and explain that every cue has a written equivalent
source_contract.music_fallback: gui/music-stem-contract.mjs: Music unavailable or suppressed; the visible heading, status, source, and result remain complete.
source_contract.ambience_fallback: gui/ambience-contract.mjs: Ambience unavailable; written setting and decision-relevant text remain complete.
source_contract.audio_muted_fallback: gui/audio.mjs: Audio muted; visual and text equivalents remain active.
source_contract.cues_only_behavior: gui/audio.mjs: Cues-only mode enabled; music and ambience are off

evaluation_sequence.prompt: Begin with audio off, inspect the visible briefing and one committed result, and identify the written meaning before enabling any sound.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: The audio status and equivalent copy state that visual and text equivalents are active.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator can identify the decision-relevant meaning without sound

evaluation_sequence.prompt: Enable full audio and compare one interface cue, one event cue, one music state, and one ambience context with the same visible text.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: Audio is requested only from visible page, host-result, or actor-visible source/status context.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator reports whether audio adds useful timing/category emphasis or increases distraction

evaluation_sequence.prompt: Switch to cues-only and repeat a visible action/result sequence, noting whether interface and event cues remain distinguishable while music and ambience stop.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: Cues-only retains interface/event channels and suppresses music and ambience.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator reports whether the cues-only mode preserves useful meaning with acceptable load

evaluation_sequence.prompt: Use mute and reduced notifications independently, then inspect the status, written result, and any changed local preference label.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: Mute clears playback while reduced notifications suppress non-music notifications; neither changes host state or removes written output.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator can explain what is intentionally suppressed and what remains available

evaluation_sequence.prompt: Use an unavailable or failed audio condition and move focus away and back; use the written fallback and continue the same host-mediated task.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: Failure/focus loss pauses optional playback, reports recovery status, and preserves visible source/equivalent text.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator retains trust and can continue without treating audio failure as a game-state failure

evaluation_sequence.prompt: With audio disabled, reconstruct one visible consequence using the status, source, result, history, or debrief text.
evaluation_sequence.technical_observation: Written equivalents remain available for cues, music, ambience, monthly results, history, and debrief.
evaluation_sequence.human_measure: evaluator reports any lost meaning and distinguishes preference from defect

review_questions: Does audio add useful category or timing information beyond the visible source, status, and result text?
Which mode—full, cues-only, muted/audio-off, or reduced notifications—best supports concentration for this evaluator, and why?
Are interface cues, event cues, music states, and ambience contexts distinguishable without implying hidden state or outcome certainty?
Does unavailable, failed, muted, or focus-paused audio preserve enough written meaning to continue the host-mediated task?
Does reduced notifications suppress unwanted interruptions without removing a decision-relevant written result?
Does the audio presentation create fatigue, urgency, distraction, or accessibility friction, and is the observation a defect, preference, or scope expansion?
What revision, if any, should be recorded before a human go/no-go decision?

response_shape.rating_scale: 1=very poor or confusing; 5=very clear or useful; not-observed is allowed
response_shape.qualitative_comment_rule: bounded de-identified observation only; no names, contact details, health information, private game state, browser URLs, session IDs, screenshots, recordings, or raw identifying transcripts

accessibility_and_fallback_checks.status: executable fallback contract; human recovery review pending
technical control present; human load review pending
technical source-bound; human recovery review pending
technical focus order source-bound; human keyboard review pending

authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.host_authority: The Rust host owns session state, transitions, validation, submission, resolution, history, replay, checkpointing, and visible event inputs.
authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.browser_authority: The browser may store local presentation/audio preferences and render host-provided visible summaries; it may not infer hidden state or perform transitions.
authority_privacy_provenance_boundary.audio_provenance: Current audio is repository-authored deterministic Web Audio synthesis with no third-party audio files; registry and credits remain the provenance authority.
forbidden_claims: audio fatigue or listening quality result
repository_privacy_limits: No private game state or hidden rival actions
No browser URLs or session IDs
No screenshots, recordings, or raw identifying transcripts

release_boundary.approval_authority: authorized human evaluator and project owner
